verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs show it tracks "monitored computers" alongside personnel in audit scope, and its API supports evidence collection from Mobile Device Managers, so some first-party workstation monitoring exists. The evidence never names the specific checks or a device agent, and the MDM mention is framed as an API building block for custom integrations rather than a turnkey integration. missing for 10: documented disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks, a documented device agent or native MDM integration, explicit per-employee device-to-owner compliance tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: review the resources, personnel, and monitored computers in scope for each engagement

The Vanta API lets you automate evidence collection and testing across a wide range of system categories, including security awareness training, background checks, Mobile Device Managers (MDM),  vulnerability scanners, and more.
